title: EntraIdentityBinding
description: Operator-controlled Entra identity management binding (FR-201). This configuration is not a public registry YAML kind or API resource. Contains no credential value; the first client-secret resolver is for local development acceptance only.

tenantId.description: Internal Muistamo tenant ID. This is a separate identifier from the Entra directory.

bindingVersion.description: Immutable binding version. A changed directory, blueprint, sponsors or credential reference/version requires a new binding version.

entraTenantId.description: Customer Entra directory ID; used in the fixed Microsoft token authority.

blueprintAppId.description: Blueprint application ID, used for authentication and Graph agentIdentityBlueprintId.

blueprintObjectId.description: Blueprint application object ID, retained for operator reconciliation.

blueprintPrincipalId.description: Blueprint service principal object ID, retained for operator reconciliation.

sponsorUserIds.description: Explicit sponsor user object IDs. No directory-wide user search.

credentialRef.description: Opaque operator credential reference; never an inline credential, URL or filesystem path.

credentialVersion.description: Immutable version resolved with credentialRef. Token reuse is confined to this binding and credential version.
